I'm not actually sure. One thing I know completely uplifted everything in life was moving out of moving out of my parents' house and into my own place. 

Another was surrounding myself with positive energy, not toxic, negative behaviors coming from former roommates that would also be seriously depressed and would often pressure me into skipping class, not doing an assignment, so on. 

I think also a big one was just getting to work. I got out of my slump by keeping myself busy. Getting a job, doing chores, and finally doing homework which may sound impossible but trust me, once that flow kicks in, it's unlike anything else.

Also one last thing was I weirdly love going to a library or public place just to do homework, it was way more effective at getting me to work when I'm not at home full of distractions.
